note: Recently remodeled Shoshone NF campground in mature pine and fir near Brooks Lake Creek Falls, about 25 mi NW of Dubois on US 26/287, with an overlook of the falls. --Claude
summary: FS page: 54 sites, FCFS (no rec.gov listing), $20 non-electric / $30 electric, cash or check, 16-day limit, 32-ft spurs, vault toilets + potable water + bear boxes, open mid/late June to ~Oct 20. Electric is 30 A (Campendium; ~20 sites in Loop A) - FS gives no amperage. Not waterfront confirmed (creek ~100 m+ from the nearest loop across meadow and trees).
flags: Amperage source: the FS page lists electric sites but no amperage; 30 A rests on the Campendium listing and a 2023 review ('The A Loop has 20 electric sites'), written as method 'reported'.
Missing phone: empty -> 307-455-2466 (Wind River Ranger District, FS page).

Waterfront 'not waterfront' confirmed on Esri imagery: Brooks Lake Creek (~5 m wide) is ~100 m+ from the nearest pad of the southern loop (~43.7046,-109.9688) across meadow and trees; the north loop is ~150 m+ across the open meadow.
Pin 43.7064,-109.9707 sits at the north loop junction; FS point 43.70482,-109.96988 is in the south loop. Both inside the camp; no move.
Camper fit reports (Campendium 2026): a 39-ft Class A at site 7 and a 35-ft trailer at site 43 - longer than the FS 32-ft spur figure; FS value kept.
